title: [SP Backbone] rr1 unreachable — iBGP sessions dropping
symptom: PE nodes losing iBGP sessions to rr1 (100.68.0.101). L3VPN customer routes disappearing. No hardware alarms. Triage using SP backbone orchestrator.
root_cause: p5 eth1 interface (toward rr1) set to OSPF passive — OSPF adjacency drops, rr1 loopback becomes unreachable, iBGP sessions drop
fix_command: delete protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface eth1 passive
